parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Identifies one logical mutation attempt. Authentication and secret-bearing session mutations retain an encrypted replay for 15 minutes and protect key conflicts for 24 hours. parameters.description: Optional caller trace value. Use only ASCII letters, digits, dot, underscore, colon, slash, or hyphen; credential-looking prefixes are rejected. Authorization denial audit uses a separate server-generated request id.
